# Pixel Foundery

> Build anything with your kid + AI

Pixel Foundery is a prompt generator for parents who want to build things with their kids using AI chatbots (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini). It generates ready-to-paste prompts that produce working single-file HTML projects.

## What it does

- Generates age-appropriate (2-5) project prompts based on kid's interests
- 6 categories: games, stories, art tools, science experiments, math puzzles, music makers
- 25+ prompt templates with age and interest personalization
- Output is a complete prompt designed to produce a working HTML file

## Who it's for

Parents, homeschoolers, and teachers who want to use AI as a creative tool with young children. Solves the "blank prompt box" problem — you don't need to know what to ask for.
